patterns.documentation_pattern: Use markdown files for comprehensive documentation, similar to README.md structure
patterns.migration_pattern: Migration files are numbered sequentially (001, 002, etc.) in supabase/migrations/ directory
patterns.compliance_pattern: Turkish Trade Ministry regulations require immutable price records (INSERT-only, no UPDATE/DELETE)

existing_implementations.description: README.md contains brief migration descriptions and mentions the price_ledger immutability pattern

key_concepts.price_ledger_immutability: Core compliance requirement - prices stored in separate table with INSERT-only pattern
key_concepts.rls_policies: Row Level Security ensures multi-tenant data isolation
key_concepts.current_prices_view: View that provides current active prices from the immutable ledger
key_concepts.package_management: Dynamic feature flags and subscription plans stored in database

migrations_to_document.description: Products and immutable price_ledger with INSERT-only constraint
